title: Five questions you will likely hear in your next interview.
“Tell me about yourself.”
sub: Keep it to two minutes: where you are now, what brought you here, and why this role.

title: “Why do you want this role?”
sub: Connect your skills to what they need, not only to what you want.

title: “Describe a problem you solved.”
sub: Use STAR: situation, task, action, result.

title: “What is your biggest weakness?”
sub: Name a real one and show what you are doing to improve it.
